title: Creamy Dairy-Free Vegan Soups: Mushroom-Wild Rice, Cauliflower-Potato, Tomato Rosemary, White Bean & Kale, and Pea (Goodful)
summary: This Goodful video showcases an array of dairy-free vegan soups, each built around a core technique: turning vegetables and aromatics into creamy, comforting bowls without dairy. The host demonstrates cauliflower-potato soup to hide veggies, a creamy mushroom and wild rice soup with mushroom soaking, sautéing, and white-wine deglazing, a dairy-free umami mushroom soup finished with coconut milk, a roasted tomato rosemary soup that uses a rosemary-grater trick, a white bean and kale soup with lemon-olive oil brightness, and a dairy-free creamy pea soup. Across segments, viewers learn practical kitchen steps such as soaking mushrooms, thickening with flour, simmering grains, blending to creamed textures, and finishing with vegan parmesan, lemon zest olive oil, and fresh herbs. The video also references specific Goodful tools and pantry-staple ingredients to help home cooks reproduce the recipes.
topics: oat milk and coconut milk creaminess

sections.title: Cauliflower-Potato Soup (Hidden Veggies)
sections.description: The host demonstrates boiling potatoes and cauliflower then blending to create a creamy soup; notes that the recipe is linked in the comments for viewers to try.

sections.title: Creamy Mushroom and Wild Rice Soup
concepts: onion, celery, carrot with herbs and garlic
sections.description: This segment covers soaking mushrooms in warm broth, sautéing until liquid cooks out, adding aromatics, thickening with flour, deglazing with white wine, simmering wild rice in broth, then finishing with oat milk and parsley for a dairy-free creamy result.

sections.title: Roasted Tomato Rosemary Soup (Holiday Gift)
sections.description: A holiday-leaning tomato-rosemary soup begins with roasting vegetables, followed by puréeing and simmering with broth; includes a rosemary-grater trick to release leaves and a note on serving with Parmesan substitutes and rosemary garnish.

sections.title: White Bean and Kale Soup (Gift-Ready)
concepts: white beans and kale in broth
sections.description: Sautéed aromatics with beans and kale, boosted by lemon-zested olive oil and herbs; the mixture reduces to concentrate flavors, then finished with kale and seasonings for a portionable, gift-worthy soup.

sections.title: Dairy-Free Creamy Pea Soup
sections.description: A quick dairy-free pea soup using sautéed aromatics, smashed garlic, peas and water, then blended to a creamy texture with optional coconut milk topping for finishing.
